does_not_discharge: runtime-change-review. Judging a design never establishes that the exact bytes that were finally written match it, and a design review performed AFTER implementation is retrospective: it is honest evidence about the design and it does not turn the missed pre-implementation gate into one that happened. A later green gate cannot erase an earlier mandatory gate that never happened.
